## Toolchain
- Unity 2D action RPG using the new Input System (not legacy Input Manager). Input actions are defined in `Assets/Scripts/Player Controls.inputactions`.
- No CLI build/test/lint commands: This project is built and run via the Unity Editor.

## Key Scripts (Assets/Scripts/)
- `PlayerController.cs`: WASD movement, J (punch), K (kick) attacks, player attack logic.
- `PlayerHealth.cs`: Player health, UI health slider, death handling.
- `EnemyAI.cs`: Enemy chase, attack, death logic.
- `EnemyPathfinding.cs`: Basic enemy movement.
- `EnemySpawner.cs`: Periodic enemy spawning near the player.
